profile.headline: Software Engineering Contractor
profile.summary:
Senior software engineer and architect with over 20 years of work experience.

- Most experienced with C/C++ and assembly languages, on Win PC and embedded micros; but a generalist with exposure to numerous platforms, frameworks, languages, and tools.

- Analytical, problem solver, detail-oriented, quick at learning new tools, persistent at making things work.

- Strong at architecting using OOP patterns of encapsulation for evolutionary development and reuse.

- Proficient with C++ class design, vertical & horizontal segmentation, cross-platform porting issues, threading and event architectures, domain framework design, and re-architecting legacy code.

- Special experience with hardware device interfacing, threaded multitasking, and embedded firmware.

- Special expertise with numerous forms of imaging technologies.
(These include camera acquisition, scanning, image processing, image manipulation, graphics, printing technologies, photography, color reproduction, and fundamental color science.)

- Strong at testing, diagnosis, and debugging.

- Good with human factors design of user interfaces and product workflows.

- Good at balancing between customer requirements, R&D efforts, testing, and production concerns.

- Good writing, documentation, mentoring, and training skills.

- Experienced with many flavors of development process, iterative development, evolving best practices, writing guidelines and specs, performing design and code reviews.

- Experienced with small and large group projects, onsite or globally distributed, and in multiple roles as developer, tester, tech lead, project lead, architect, contractor and consultant.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
I'm interested in a broad range of application domains including imaging, medical devices, process & machine control, bioinformatics, robotics, user visualization, and domain framework library design.

Recent work has included biomedical instrument control, interfacing to newer Andor CCD cameras, refactoring old domain framework code.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer - contract
positions.description: Part-time contract.  Working on software for reading systems for the blind and vision impaired.  Interfacing to video cameras and Abbyy OCR library.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer - Contract
positions.description:
Contract, working on software framework for medical instrument.
C++, boost, and C# on Win7 and Linux.  Generating state machines from UML diagrams, logging support, interprocess control.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer - contract
positions.description: Part-time contract.  Working on software for reading systems for the blind and vision impaired.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer - contract
positions.description: Part-time contract, working remotely from home office.  Developed embedded app for controlling prototype biomedical instrument hardware.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed software for imaging & measurement instruments for biomedical screening.  Work included control and processing for an intensified CCD camera, control of fluidics pipettor operations, laser autofocus subsystem, robotic slideloader, multithreading and state machine designs, OOP class libraries, analysis app GUI, reverse engineering and refactoring of undocumented legacy code, testing and sustaining.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer - contract
positions.description: Temporary contract.  Worked onsite in Microsoft’s Mt. View campus as part of Canon team that implemented the WCS color management transform engine for the Vista OS.  Worked on color device profiling utilities and testing code for software verification.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed PC based imaging & analysis instruments for biomedical applications (electrophoresis gel and microarray imaging.)  Primary architect & technical lead implementing reusable multithreaded OOP class libraries for camera acquisition, image manipulation, display, and analysis.  The acquisition subsystem interfaced with various CCD cameras, positioning stage, light cabinet, and lens control hardware, with auto exposure, auto focus, auto registration, dynamic range extension, and image stitching features.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Various short term projects: data-collection terminal, embedded barcode subsystem, embedded code for a line of medical force measurement instruments for Chatillon, custom color calibration procedures, and Photoshop plug-ins.

positions.title: Cofounder, Head of Software Development
positions.description: Developed several ground-breaking full-color imaging systems for use in novelty, DTP, prepress, screen printing, and textile applications, including the invention of a novel sublimation printing process, and solutions for device calibration, halftoning, & color reproduction.

positions.title: Head of Software Development
positions.description: Developed printer hardware interfacing, embedded firmware for video frame grabber, some of the first color contone PC drivers for the new generation of desktop color printers, including ink-jet, impact, thermal wax, and laser technologies.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: Developed software for real-time radar (SLAR) image exploitation systems.

educations.schoolName: California Polytechnic State University-San Luis Obispo
